goal: Keep shipping by closing the loop on started work. Never silent-merge.

actions.finish: One ready or newest draft PR on a crowded repo — review and land or close.
actions.park: Leave extra drafts. Do not open a new agent on the same repo.
actions.stop: Title matches work already on main, or PR is empty/stale with no commits — close or stop the agent.
actions.wait: Draft younger than staleDays — do not nag.
